notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Performance, new features and bugfixes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/00555f517d123c569ce655ead6d476cc384d3152.png[/img]

Hey Champions! 
Thank you for the awesome feedback on the game, we're so excited to be live in Early Access!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]HOPEFULLY a huge performance boost[/b]! We've recompiled the game with a new compiler (ILCCP for you coders out there!)
[*] Added a new Obelisk upgrade to [b]Auto Pickup Loot[/b]!
[*] Added verbose descriptions to some of the tower upgrades
[*] Towers boosted by the Obelisk now says "Boosted" next to the kill count!
[*] Freeplay now gives you 50% XP and loot chance! (down from 100%)
[*] Added AUTO settings that will check what quality settings to use on your FIRST launch - this will run once for everyone so if you edited your settings you might have to change them again (only once, sorry!)
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that locked you in Freeplay forever!
[*] Fixed an error on the Lightning Tower L2T5 upgrade where the range was reduced
[*] Obelisks won't boost other Obelisks anymore, how silly that was
[*] Fixed the placement of the Obelisk that was a little bit off!
[*] Fixed a bug that displayed removed AOE damage as 0,0
[/list]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/823d21df1217bc6e7a5745486f83a7e35978bae8.png[/img]

Houston we don't have a problem - we're doing amazing! Cliff & Field is now released in Early Access and you're more than welcome to come and try it out.

Over 2 years in the making from us two devs, everything from music to 3D assets and it's been such a joyride!

We hope you like this early access version and that you want to support us as we keep developing this game together with you all!

Thank you! <3

Best,
Gideon & Maximillian

notes.title: New demo update - now WAY better performance!
notes.notes:
Hello champions,

We’re super excited to release this new update where we worked a lot on improving the performance while playing the game.

We received feedback from a lot of you that it needed to run smoother and faster so we set out to accomplish exactly that. This is our first update of many to address performance.

[b]Here’s what’s included in this update 0.9.5:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved accessibility why am picking up loot including particle effects
[*] Improved terrain performance 
[*] Occlusion culling (to improve rendering performance, silly of us to have disabled that)
[*] Mesh grouping (also for improved performance)
[/list]

We hope this update allows more people to play the game and please let us know in the steam community if you encounter any errors and will try to fix the best we can in the next coming days!

Thanks for playing!
Gideon
